question: When `coroutine.resume(co)` returns, what is useful to check first?
options: Its first result is the success Boolean, followed by yielded/returned values or an error
It always returns the coroutine function only
It always throws errors into the caller
It returns the OS thread ID
answer_key: Its first result is the success Boolean, followed by yielded/returned values or an error
explanation: resume returns a Boolean followed by values on success or an error value on failure.
